f_trend.name: Downtrend, momentum falling
f_trend.short: below the 50- and 200-day averages with a falling MACD histogram
conditions: MACD histogram lower than the day before
why_not: build years: +2.1 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)
check years: -0.7 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)

f_break.name: Breakdown on heavy volume
f_break.short: close below the lowest close of the previous 40 sessions on 1.5x volume
conditions: Close below the lowest close of the previous 40 sessions
Volume at least 1.5 times the 50-day average
why_not: build years: +0.5 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)
check years: -2.5 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)

f_failed.name: Failed breakout
f_failed.short: back under a 40-day high it broke in the last 5 sessions, on 1.5x volume
conditions: Closed above its 40-day high in the last 5 sessions and is back under that level today
Volume at least 1.5 times the 50-day average
why_not: build years: -0.4 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)
check years: -0.3 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)

f_weak.name: Weak and slipping
f_weak.short: RSI under 40 with a falling 50-day average
why_not: build years: +0.7 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)
check years: -0.9 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)

f_stretch.name: Stretched volatile stock
f_stretch.short: daily range 5% or more and more than 25% above the 50-day average
conditions: Daily range (14-day average true range) at least 5% of the price
Close more than 25% above the 50-day average

f_wash.name: Market washout
f_wash.short: fewer than 20% of the market's stocks above their 50-day average
conditions: Market washout: fewer than 20% of the market's stocks close above their own 50-day average
why_not: build years: +1.0 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)
check years: -4.2 points over the same-volatility base rate (needs 5)
